main_measure.name: pooled excess forward 5-bar return after forecast <= -10 (minus holding baseline)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: negative with t <= -2 and negative in >= 2 of 3 coins; reject: positive with t >= +2; min 30 non-overlapping cases

supporting_check.name: number of coins (of 3) with negative mean excess return

decided_by: Only 3 non-overlapping extreme cases pooled, below the plan's minimum of 30.
reading: Holding baseline is the mean forward 5-bar return over all bars of the coin's window with a valid forward return (overlapping), extreme cases are the non-overlapping grid bars (positions 0,5,10,... of each window) with forecast <= -10, t is the ordinary t of the pooled mean, and a coin absent from the record or without cases counts as not negative among the plan's 3 coins.
